description: MarTech was never the plan B for us — it was the whole point. Brands don't need more posts. They need plumbing. So in 2022, we started building it — automation, attribution, AI agents, and dashboards designed to show what's actually working, not what looks good on a deck. CGI and production came next. Then a performance engine that connected strategy, creative, media, and conversion into one continuous loop instead of five different vendors working in silos. Along the way, we partnered with 50+ brands, helping legacy businesses rebuild for a digital-first world, while building a 500+ creator network most agencies would call a department of its own. What started as a creative studio has evolved into something bigger. A few years in, 100+ brands globally, and a full-stack MarTech and creative technology partner built for the way modern businesses actually grow. The philosophy hasn't changed: build the infrastructure, connect the dots, make marketing work harder. And the people who built it are still the ones running it. Meet the team.
